parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the first page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that results are returned starting from page 1.

parameters.name: MachineRemark
parameters.description: The identification information of the server that is protected by the anti-ransomware policy you want to query. You can enter the IP address or instance ID of the server.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the anti-ransomware mitigation policy that you want to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of backup policies per page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 mitigation policies.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the anti-ransomware mitigation policy.

- **enabled**: The policy is manually enabled.

- **disabled**: The policy is manually disabled. After the policy is disabled, running backup nodes are stopped.

- **closed**: The anti-ransomware capacity is exceeded, and the system disables the policy.
